title: Pokémon Bulk 500+ cards including some special Mega EX, EX and 30th cards
description:
Bulk 500+ cards - all in new condition (never played).

Includes;

* Standard cards (English and Japanese)
* Holographic cards
* A few Mega Ex and Ex cards.
* Some Holo cards included from 30th celebration including Eevee
* Plus a few other special cards full art.
